Check out the help icons on the website for some extra information.

Otherwise you can find more information about the dashboard here - https://copiwiki.cornucopias.io/documentation/nodes/public-pools-dashboard

Greg mentioned in the previously: there is not a lot separating a 5 bar from a 1 bar.  Once we get more traffic, I think we will start to see the separation.
@Tony the Brick 🌽Mafia Whisperer  Are you running a public node?  Open a support ticket and get your pool back on track.

All pools will have the same opportunity to earn rewards.  The strength does not determine what your reward potential can be.  More on this later.  I don't want you to be too concerned about the strength and where you are.  Everyone should be able to host a pool.  However, not all pools provide the best download experience for the users.

The strength is merely a way to for us to provide the best download experience.  This is focused around the download rate (bytes/sec) because we believe that will provide the best experience for users downloading the game.

Why does it matter for delegations? The more delegates that your pool has, the more requests that will be directed to your pool.
